source.title: How is the Beads Task related to intolerance of uncertainty in anxiety disorders?

confidence_rationale: Secondary support for Q2: a diagnosed-anxiety-disorder sample (mixed anxiety diagnoses, not GAD-only) shows more subjective distress during the beads task than non-anxious controls, and within the anxious group self-reported intolerance of uncertainty correlates with draws-to-decision and distress. This links the same information-sampling paradigm to IU, the construct MECH-080's original arm-2 mechanism (MECH-078, chronically high uncertainty) most directly names. Held to 0.45 because the reported group-level result is about DISTRESS during the task, not draws-to-decision itself; the draws-to-decision/IU link is a within-group correlation in the anxious sample only, not a clean between-group behavioural dissociation, and no computational model is fit.
failure_signatures: If MECH-080's arm 2 needs a behavioural (draws-to-decision) group difference between anxious and non-anxious people and this paper's own between-group comparison is on distress rather than draws-to-decision, citing it as behavioural support for anxiety on arm 2 overstates what was actually shown.

IU correlating with draws-to-decision only within the already-anxious group (not as a between-group predictor) is consistent with IU being a severity marker within anxiety rather than a general population-wide driver of over-sampling, which would matter for any REE manipulation trying to model IU as a continuous set-point.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Individuals with anxiety disorders reported greater distress during a beads uncertainty-induction task than non-anxious controls; within the anxious group, self-reported intolerance of uncertainty correlated with both draws-to-decision and task-related distress.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports the construct link between IU and the arm-2 information-sampling paradigm that MECH-080's original arm-2 mechanism (MECH-078, chronically high uncertainty) was built around, giving Q2 option (c) -- commissioning a targeted pull on anxiety/IU in information-sampling tasks -- a modest positive lead rather than a null result.
mapping.mapping_caveat: No computational model; the headline group difference is on subjective distress, not draws-to-decision, and the draws-to-decision/IU correlation is within-group only. Clinical anxiety-disorder sample mixes diagnoses (not GAD-specific), so it cannot itself separate anxiety from compulsivity the way Hauser's specificity claim requires.
mapping.source_context: Adults with a primary anxiety disorder diagnosis vs non-anxious controls; beads task; self-report Intolerance of Uncertainty Scale correlated post hoc with task behaviour and distress.

confidence_components.notes: Older (2014), modest clinical sample, self-report-heavy design with no computational decomposition. Included as corroborating context for Rapp 2024 rather than as a standalone strong entry -- it establishes the IU-anxiety-sampling link has prior independent support, not only the 2024 valuation-model result.
